description: A biomechanical engineer needs a density-graded Finite Element Analysis (FEA) model of the skull. Starting with the loaded CT Cranium dataset, create three separate segmentation masks based on Hounsfield Unit (HU) density ranges: (1) Low Density (226 to 600 HU), (2) Medium Density (601 to 1200 HU), and (3) High Density (1201 to max/3071 HU). Generate a 3D surface for EACH mask. To visualize material properties, configure the surface colors: Low Density = Blue, Medium Density = Green, High Density = Red. Save the project to /home/ga/Documents/fea_skull.inv3.
